# What the Word export needs: pdf2docx and everything it pulls in, pinned to
# an exact version with the hash of every distribution of that version.
# server/typst/pdf-to-docx/convert.py is the only thing that imports any of
# it, and the Dockerfile installs this file with `pip --require-hashes`, so a
# changed artefact on PyPI fails the build instead of shipping.
#
# Generated, not hand written. The regeneration command and what else to
# re-run after a bump are in the Dockerfile, beside the stage that installs
# this.
#
# Running from source instead of Docker:
#   python3 -m venv .venv-pdf2docx
#   .venv-pdf2docx/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r server/typst/pdf-to-docx/requirements.txt
#   export PDF2DOCX_PYTHON="$PWD/.venv-pdf2docx/bin/python"
